item.title: Smecta 3 g diosmectite oral suspension powder, 30 sachets
item.description: Smecta contains diosmectite, a natural purified clay that coats the intestinal lining and binds bacteria, viruses and toxins, helping to treat and stop the symptoms of acute diarrhoea of any cause, without speeding up or slowing down normal digestion. It is suitable for adults and children from age 2. Active substance: diosmectite 3 g Form: oral powder sachet Pack size: 30 sachets How to use: Dissolve the contents of one sachet in half a glass of water just before drinking. Adults take 3 sachets daily; children from 2 years take 2 sachets daily, doubled at the start of treatment if needed. Use for up to 7 days in adults, 3 days in children; take alongside an oral rehydration solution. Warnings: May cause constipation. See a doctor if symptoms do not improve or worsen. Not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Read the patient information leaflet before use.

item.title: JutaVit Zinc 15 mg tablets, 60 tablets
item.description: JutaVit Zinc tablets provide 15 mg of zinc per tablet, a trace mineral involved in DNA synthesis, fertility, protein synthesis and many everyday body functions. item.title: Allergodil nasal spray, 5 ml
item.description: Allergodil nasal spray treats the symptoms of seasonal allergic rhinitis (hay fever) and year-round allergic rhinitis. It contains azelastine, an antihistamine that blocks H1 receptors directly in the nose and works with a fairly long duration of action. Active substance: azelastine 0.1% Form: nasal spray Pack size: 5 ml How to use: Adults and children from 6 years apply one spray into each nostril twice daily, with the head upright. Before first use, prime the pump 2-3 times until an even spray is produced. Wipe the nozzle with a dry cloth after use and replace the cap. Warnings: Not for children under 6 years. Avoid during the first trimester of pregnancy and during breastfeeding unless advised by a doctor. Store above 8 degrees C; discard 6 months after opening. Read the patient information leaflet before use.

item.title: Flebaven 500 mg film-coated tablets, 90 tablets
item.description: Flebaven 500 mg tablets contain pure, micronized diosmin, a venotonic flavonoid that strengthens vein walls, reduces capillary permeability and improves lymphatic drainage. It relieves symptoms of chronic venous disease, such as heavy, tired or restless legs, night cramps and swelling, and eases the symptoms of haemorrhoids. Active substance: diosmin 500 mg Form: film-coated tablet Pack size: 90 tablets How to use: For chronic venous disease, take 2 tablets daily with food for at least 4 to 5 weeks. For acute haemorrhoids, take 6 tablets daily for 4 days, then 4 tablets daily for 3 days, then maintain on 2 tablets daily; use short-term only for this indication. Warnings: Not recommended for children or adolescents, or during breastfeeding. Use during pregnancy only with medical advice. Do not use if allergic to diosmin. Read the patient information leaflet before use.

item.title: Xyzal 5 mg tablets, 7 tablets
item.description: Xyzal 5 mg tablets contain levocetirizine dihydrochloride, an antiallergic medicine used to treat symptoms of allergic rhinitis, including persistent (year-round) allergic rhinitis, and hives (swelling, redness and burning of the skin). Active substance: levocetirizine 5 mg Form: tablet Pack size: 7 tablets How to use: Adults and adolescents from 6 years take one tablet daily, swallowed whole with liquid, independent of food. Warnings: Not recommended for children under 6 years or patients with severe kidney impairment. Contains lactose. item.description: Olfen FORTE is a topical gel containing diclofenac 23.2 mg/g, a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicine used for the short-term relief of pain from muscle strains, sprains and bruising after blunt injury in adults and adolescents from 14 years. item.title: Helicid 20 mg gastro-resistant capsules, 14 capsules
item.description: Helicid 20 mg contains omeprazole, a proton pump inhibitor that reduces the amount of acid produced by the stomach. It is used, without a doctor's advice, for short-term symptomatic treatment of reflux symptoms such as heartburn and acid regurgitation in adults, and, under medical supervision, for stomach and duodenal ulcers and reflux oesophagitis. Active substance: omeprazole 20 mg Form: gastro-resistant capsule Pack size: 14 capsules How to use: For self-treated reflux, take one capsule once daily for 14 days, best in the morning on an empty stomach, swallowed whole with water. It may take 2 to 3 days for symptoms to ease; stop once symptoms have gone. Warnings: See a doctor if symptoms persist beyond 14 days, if you have unexplained weight loss, difficulty swallowing, vomiting blood or a suspected stomach ulcer. Read the patient information leaflet before use.
